title: natural-series orbit versus independent trend residual sweep
hypothesis: On heterogeneous natural forecasting series, a shared pretrained temporal backbone with a compact series View plus sparse private trend residual can match or improve held-out forecasts while using less actual serialized state than separate series-specific forecast heads. The added View must beat a byte-matched ordinary low-rank or affine control.
physical_object: One shared multiseries temporal backbone and common forecast interface.
mirror_coordinate: A low-dimensional series-specific View coordinate inferred from train history; optional sparse private trend residual only when a development-only rule selects it.
logical_multiplicity: Forecast functions across naturally heterogeneous series families from one shared physical model.

prior_art.PA328: Moirai universal time-series transformer already shares across frequencies and variates; Mirror must add value beyond native conditioning.
prior_art.PA330: TimeMixer mixes multi-scale seasonal/trend signals; compare against its native scale-mixing and simple scale gates.
prior_art.PA335: N-BEATS uses interpretable shared bases; basis coefficients are a direct non-Mirror control.

controls: hard sharing with no series code
byte-matched additive or diagonal gain / low-rank residual
independent per-series forecast heads as quality upper bound
seasonal naive and persistence where valid

design.datasets: Select a public multiseries benchmark with metadata/semantics and documented license; balance stationary/nonstationary, scale, holiday and trend groups. No benchmark selection by audit scores.
design.split: Split by complete series identity and chronological blocks; development selects all ranks, regularization and private-residual threshold. Freeze before fresh series and future windows are read.
design.primary_metric: Per-series normalized forecast error (MASE or benchmark primary); report group and worst-quartile metrics.
design.compute: Use container CPU/GPU available; report hardware and active MAC/FLOP proxy. No parameter-count-only storage claim.

success_gate: On fresh complete-series holdout, Mirror beats native shared and byte-matched simple control by at least 2% on primary metric, remains within 5% of independent-head quality, and reduces actual complete payload versus independent heads; all replay and split checks pass.
failure_gate: Mirror fails any quality gate; simple control matches within 0.1%; private residual is needed for most series or removes storage gain; or actual bytes/compute erase the frontier.
not_established_gate: No suitable licensed public dataset, unable to reproduce required controls, or split/data provenance cannot be verified.
boundaries: One model/data family is screening evidence, not broad time-series capacity evidence.
View coordinates count as payload together with bases, mappings, normalization and residual state.
Do not use audit results to select architecture or thresholds.
A candidate private residual must be included in full byte and runtime costs.
